note.after_visit_summary: You have a sprain of the ligaments on the outside of your right ankle from basketball. There is swelling and bruising, and it hurts when you walk. We did not need an X-ray based on your exam. To help it heal: ice your ankle for 15-20 minutes every few hours for the next two days, keep it raised on a pillow, and wear a compression wrap. We will give you a lace-up ankle brace to wear during sports for the next couple months. Take ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth every 8 hours with food for 5 to 7 days, then only as needed for pain. You may use crutches for a few days if walking hurts, but try to put weight on it as much as you can. Do ankle alphabet exercises by tracing letters with your toes a few times each day. Do not play basketball for about two weeks. You can return when you can hop and run without pain. If you cannot put weight on it or the pain moves to the bone, call us so we can check if you need an X-ray. If it is not much better in two weeks, come back so we can set up physical therapy. We will send a note to your school and gym class through your portal. Your mom’s cell phone number on file is 555-0192.
